text:
Toronto yɛ kurow a nnipa dɔɔso paa wɔ Canada na ɛyɛ Ontario capital. Ne nsesaeɛ kɔ 1793, bere a wɔde York settlement bɔɔ mu sɛ Upper Canada capital. 6 March 1834 mu, wɔde settlement no yɛɛ City of Toronto, na wɔde din a wɔsan de fii Indigenous mu baeɛ wɔ York ananmu.

Nne Toronto yɛ Canada sikakorabea ne amammerɛ mfinimfini na ɛyɛ kurow a ɛwɔ amammerɛ bebree paa wɔ wiase. Ne 2021 census nnipa dodoɔ yɛ 2,794,356 na ɛyɛ kurow a nnipa dɔɔso a ɛto so anan wɔ North America, Mexico City, New York ne Los Angeles akyi. Kurow no yɛ Canada host kurow mmienu a ɛwɔ 2026 World Cup mu, a ɛka Vancouver ho. Ne tournament beaeɛ, BMO Field, wɔ Exhibition Place wɔ Lake Ontario mpoano.

Toronto ne football amammerɛ wɔ hɔ paa, na ɛwɔ BMO Field ankasa. Beaeɛ no yɛ MLS Toronto FC fie, a wɔbɔɔ mu wɔ 2007, na wɔn 2017 MLS Cup nkonim a wɔwieeɛ wɔ beaeɛ no mu no yɛɛ nnipa a wɔpɛ no ma wɔn. Ɛyɛ Canada mmarima ɔman kuo fie nso. Beaeɛ no wɔ soccer pedigree a wɔyɛɛ no sɛdeɛ, na wɔde 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup, 2014 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup ne club friendlies a wɔne Real Madrid bɔɔ no.

Ɛne kurow no immigrant nnipa bebree, saa soccer-specific heritage no ma Toronto ne football identity – yei yɛ football beaeɛ ankasa, ɛnyɛ deɛ wɔbɔɔ mu.
